text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0840 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower in old crop on bearishly construed USDA soybean estimates and some bearish interpretations of UGG's canola output forecast Wednesday. Funds widely believed to be short 5,000 July contracts, some traders expect funds to cover soon, others suspect funds will wait until delivery time for the July-Nov spread to collapse and then roll positions. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -8.94 Wednesday from -12.99 Tuesday. New crop November seen down C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne on USDA and UGG output outlooks.

Hot, dry weather on the eastern Prairies were expected to become a significant market factor if the region does not see rain next week. The Canadian dollar was down at C$1.3873 against the U.S. dollar, and rose to 82.12 yen and 1.2408 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$1.00 to C$2.00 down on UGG's large seeding estimate at 2.344 million acres, up 57 percent from last year's acreage of 1.49 million.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls as Alberta Wheat Pool expected to sell the July-Oct spread.

FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on USDA wheat output estimate, CBOT wheat and corn calls and news China's 1996 production was underestimated at 490 million tonnes and may be as high as 502 million tonnes. News the Canadian Wheat Board sold 52,500 tonnes of feed wheat to South Korea's Daewoo Corp at US$137 C&F was not a factor as that wheat was already sourced, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
